text:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up: compiled feedback from five mid-market accounts after onboarding calls this week — recurring asks: per-route cost visibility, faster bulk-embed import, and clearer retry/idempotency behavior. Short notes below; can PM/handoff please? @Tom @Ravi @Lina

Aisha (CS): quick notes:
- Acme & Helix: per-route billing granularity top ask (blocking renewal for Acme)
- Brightline: bulk CSV embed upload times out, UX unclear, trial paused
- SummitHealth: retry/backoff leads to duplicate records; wants explicit idempotency token support
- Multiple customers: request an admin UI for rollout/canary flags
Link to spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/feedback-3 (internal)
Can we triage into 'short fix', 'product', 'roadmap'? :thinking_face:

Tom (PM): Thanks — moving these to the product board. Quick Q: which asks are blocking renewals? @Aisha

Aisha (CS): Acme mentions renewal in ~6w unless per-route toggle ships; Brightline paused trial (medium risk); SummitHealth still in POC but active (low risk). I'll annotate account notes in the sheet.

Ravi (Product): Agree re: Acme priority. For bulk embed timeouts: suggest chunking + faster retries as a short fix. Per-route billing is larger — touches billing schema + console. Need cost/effort estimate and security/KMS review.

Lina (Eng): From infra POV: bulk upload -> chunking + async job is doable in ~2 sprints if we reuse queue infra. Idempotency needs request-id plumbing; low complexity. Per-route billing touches the billing pipeline and analytics — estimate 3-4 sprints and a dedicated PM + eng lead. We could prototype a console toggle while backend work progresses.

Tom (PM): Proposal: 1) Short fixes (chunking, idempotency) — target next sprint. 2) Per-route billing: RFC + spike next quarter. 3) Admin rollout UI: scope with PM. @Lina can you create rough JIRA epics and link them? :white_check_mark:

Lina (Eng): Will create epics and link to the spreadsheet. Flagging data retention and KMS notes for per-route billing (security review needed).

CS Bot: ticket created: FEEDBACK-1278 (bulk-embed chunking) assigned to @Lina, due 2026-04-15

Aisha (CS): :thumbsup: I'll update Acme and Brightline with expected timelines and confirm renewal cadence. Adding any more asks to the sheet and will consolidate for the renewal check-in.

Tom (PM): Perfect — moving to the board and adding priority tags. Thanks everyone.
